addresses.$comment: Roles default to the canonical karpatkey OIV Safe address used on the other 5 chains. Confirm/replace before broadcasting deploy 02 if a different Safe is preferred on BSC.

deployed.$comment: Empty until deploy scripts 01_DeployImplementations and 02_DeployProxies are broadcast on BSC. CREATE2 deployer (0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C) is present on BSC, so the implementation address will match the other chains.

ERC20Default.$comment: navCalculator is filled in after 02_DeployProxies populates `deployed.NAVCalculatorProxy` above.

PancakeSwapV2PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every PancakeSwap V2 pair (one Supply leg per token). The active pair set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = pair address; name = sym0/sym1 LP. Supersedes the per-pair PancakeSwapV2_* adapters. Disabled for the same reason as below: COW has no Chainlink feed on BSC, so the COW leg would be silently dropped. Enable once COW is priced.

PancakeSwapV2_ETH_COW.$superseded: Disabled — superseded by PancakeSwapV2PoolsMeta (ADR 0010), and independently gated on a COW price feed (see comment below).
PancakeSwapV2_ETH_COW.$comment: Cake-LP for Binance-Peg ETH (0x2170...) / CoW Protocol Token (0x5BfdAa...). Test holder 0x616dE58c011F8736fa20c7Ae5352F7f6FB9F0669 is the genesis LP. Disabled by default: COW has no Chainlink feed on BSC, so registering it would require a custom price feed first. Until that lands, NAVCalculator's per-asset registry filter would silently drop the COW leg of any PCS V2 ETH/COW LP and value the position only on its ETH side — i.e. understate it by ~half. Enable once COW is priced (or replace this entry with a different pair that has fully-priced tokens).
